motions.name: Idle Breathe
motions.description: Living companion idle: 3-beat diaphragm breath, staggered jacket lapels, double-blink + curiosity glance, lanyard swing, cap button bob, tail twitch, monocle sweep, and alternating right-heel micro-flex with grounded footing shadows.

motions.name: Wave Hello
motions.description: Energetic onboarding host: weight-transfer sway, 2-beat Figure-8 wave snap, counter-balance right wing, double-chirp beak, rhythmic right toe tap with shrinking foot shadow, cap visor tip, and expanding paw greeting ripple.

motions.name: Signature Thumbs Up
motions.description: Hero approval stamp: anticipation squash dip into thumbs-up overshoot lifting left collar, locked left-foot plant with right mini-stomp settle, wink squeeze, rotating hero starburst, cap emblem gleam flash, and proud lanyard hop.

motions.name: Recording Active
motions.description: Live workflow director: optical scanning pupils + furrowed brows, baton cue beats on raised flipper, hip-brace counter pulse, 4-bar equalizer pill, dual crimson telemetry sonar rings, whispered cue beak, and COM-tracking ground/foot shadows.

motions.name: Capture Paused
motions.description: Restful sigh hold: deep suspended chest drop, cozy inward tucked flippers flexing together, dreamy brow & eye settle, monocle cord pendulum, breathing pause bars with frost aura, relaxed tail tuck, and wide settled ground/foot shadows.

motions.name: Screenshot Snap
motions.description: 4-beat shutter precision: forward aim -> click squeeze -> kickback recoil with popped right heel + shrinking right-foot shadow, pinching viewfinder brackets, golden starburst + radial flash ring, blue iris pulse, and lagged cap button pop.

motions.name: Monocle Inspect
motions.description: Forensic OCR scrutiny: forward lean gripping & twisting monocle rim, laser scan bar sequentially illuminating text lines, pulsing target reticles, rapid reading eye saccades, tipped brim, tail rudder, and forward-weighted footing shadow.

motions.name: Local AI Thinking
motions.description: Local AI ideation: double-tap chin contemplation into eureka nod, staggered cloud pearls + triple-dot wave, timed synapse spark + halo ring, upward gaze + curious brow arch, 3/4 right-toe tap with dynamic foot shadow, and cap emblem pulse.

motions.name: Drafting Manual
motions.description: Purposeful penmanship: elliptic cursive stylus trace drawing dual blue ink lines + gliding orange nib spark, flexing paper bounce, ping-pong tracking eyes, 2x enthusiastic tail wag, carriage-return head nod, and diagonal lean footing shadow.

motions.name: Studio Annotating
motions.description: Studio presenter flourish: pullback windup into sweeping pointer extension, expanding arrow beacon ring + card perspective tilt, popping + badge glow, cheerful chirp, rear wing balance, and right-toe tap with decoupled foot shadow.

motions.name: Workflow Search
motions.description: Detective sleuth prowl: wide figure-8 magnifier sweep with lens gleam & clue sparkles, crouching knee bounce at turnarounds, creeping heel-toe rock, tracking eyes, tipping cap brim, tail rudder, and left-to-right prowling COM shadow.

motions.name: Needs Review
motions.description: Human-gate double-take: crisp head-snap double-take, symmetrical collar shoulder shrug ("Hmm?"), nervous foreground chin-tap, arched brow glance, quivering O-mouth, rocking amber triangle with dual pulse rings, and weight-shifting ankle shadow.

motions.name: Verified Draft
motions.description: Clean audit hop: ground squash into crisp bounded cheer leap shrinking main & dual foot shadows cleanly in mid-air, V-victory arm pump, asymmetric scissor-kick tiptoes, slamming emerald check stamp + shockwave ring, and 3 twinkling stars.

motions.name: Export Document
motions.description: Document dispatch heave: windup crouch into upward right-arm toss launching PDF skyward with speed ticks, left-arm brace swing, upward visor + sky-tracking pupils, right-heel push-off shrinking foot shadow, and planted left weight lock.

motions.name: Orchestrating AI
motions.description: AI maestro levitation: sinusoidal zero-G hover softening altitude-reactive ground & foot shadows, counter-conducting orb arms, clockwise outer orbital ring + counter-clockwise inner dashed ring, pulsing satellites, and floating hem wave.

motions.name: Privacy Guard
motions.description: Local-first sentry guard: wide fortress brace stomp anchoring thick footing shadows (+12px COM shift), tactical shield brace forward with prismatic sweep glaze + outer ward pulse, perimeter-scanning pupils, and pulsing emerald seal.

motions.name: Penguin Waddle
motions.description: 4-beat penguin waddle gait: elliptical alternating step clearances without floor clip, torso roll counter-balanced by head horizon lock, opposing flipper swings, 2x cap button hop, velocity speed streaks, dust puffs, and inverse L/R foot shadows.

motions.name: Milestone Cheer
motions.description: Milestone 4-stage leap: deep anticipation crouch -> vertical stretch apex (`0.58x` main shadow & `0.30x` vanishing foot shadows) -> mid-air scissor kick -> landing stomp with twin dust clouds, 4 tumbling confetti pieces, and parachute cap snapback.

motions.name: Standby Sleep
motions.description: REM nap cycle: slow belly inhale widening grounded shadows -> heavy drowsy head droop with mini-catch settle, soft snore beak puff, drooping brows & relaxed floor tail, folded wing breathe, and spiraling S-curve z-z-Z trajectory.

motions.name: Error & Recover
motions.description: Two-act recovery arc: Act I startled hop recoil shrinking ground & right-foot shadows, wing tremor shakes, crown cap pop-up, wide eye tremor & crimson alert shockwaves -> Act II stomp landing dust puff, relief exhale, calming double-blink & steady stance.
